items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you played with (inaudible) Nat Pierce and Frankie Capp [INTERVIEWEE] I play with three of the local bands here...

ctx.x: He said that Frank Sinatra was one of the entertainers who supported the merge.

Oh, he would have probably supported it, but Frankie was in the throes of trying to make a comeback at that time and he wasn't a big name. Frank Sinatra's name wasn't a yard long in 1951, '40. As a matter of fact, it was just around that time that he made the picture that --
